src: red control pixel on edge of the grid (such edges are called "control pixel edges")
path: straight line to the opposite edge
trajectory: intermittent, skipping foreground pixels (i.e. pixels of the main sprite located approximately in the center of the grid)
src2: part s cut from the main sprite by the red ray in rectangular region with at least one control pixel edge
dst2: to corner d of the grid
match_cond2: s.rectangular_region == d.rectangular_region and d has control pixel edge
src3: part s cut from the main sprite by the red ray in rectangular region without control pixel edge
notes: rectangular regions are divided by the red rays
